payload.block_text: In this module, you will be introduced to the regulatory environment that impacts the daily work of AFC professionals. In addition to learning who some of the major regulators are and what regulatory requirements they impose, you will learn how regulators assess risk, provide guidance, and cooperate with each other and with law enforcement to enforce AML/CFT laws. This material provides the context for understanding how regulatory requirements flow from international guidance to national legislation and finally to operational requirements within covered entities, impacting you as an AFC professional.
